intel.overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform that enables developers to design, build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services at enterprise scale. It provides a collaborative environment for the entire API lifecycle, empowering engineers and organizations to create better APIs faster.
intel.target_audience: Software engineers, developers, and technical teams building, testing, and managing APIs, as well as enterprises seeking scalable API collaboration and governance.

intel.overview: Supabase provides an open‑source Postgres‑based development platform that adds authentication, realtime APIs, storage, edge functions and other backend services, allowing developers to build and scale applications quickly. It offers free and paid plans, starter templates, and a global community of developers.
intel.target_audience: Developers building web, mobile, or SaaS applications who need a scalable backend platform with database, auth, realtime, storage, and API capabilities.

intel.overview: Vapi provides a unified, API‑first platform for building, testing, and deploying voice agents at enterprise scale, handling infrastructure, monitoring, and compliance. It offers usage‑based pricing, dedicated support, and built‑in AI guardrails for Fortune‑100 companies and developers.
intel.target_audience: Enterprises (including Fortune 100) and developers building voice agents who need scalable, secure, and compliant voice interaction solutions.
